title: I’m building Take It Over Mobile — conquer real-world territory, build bases and send out drones from your phone or browser
author: ScottishAI
selftext:
Hey everyone! I wanted to share **Take It Over Mobile**, a territory-conquest strategy game I’m developing on a real-world map.

You can play in your **mobile or desktop browser**, or **install it on your phone’s home screen** and launch it like an app.

👉 [**Play Take It Over Mobile**](https://gamerol.online/takeitover/)

The world is divided into **1 km² tiles**. Capture territory, earn credits and decide how to expand: build bases, launch drones, recruit troops or strengthen your defences. Neighbouring tiles you own join visually into one larger territory.

**Getting started**

**Create your account and press PLAY.** You start with **4,000 credits and a free basic drone**. English is the default language, with Spanish available in Settings.

**Capture your first tile.** Enable GPS and allow location access. Stay inside a neutral tile for around **2 seconds** with good GPS accuracy to claim it. Walking into another player’s territory won’t capture it.

**Build and name your first base.** Open **PURCHASE → Bases & Troops** and build on your territory. Each tile earns **5 credits per hour**, including while you’re offline.

**Assign your free drone to your base.** Drones launch from their assigned bases, so you don’t need to physically travel to every target. Select up to **20 connected neutral tiles**, confirm the mission and watch your drone fly out and return.

**Growing your territory**

Buy more drones at your bases and transfer them between your own bases to establish new launch points. Each base holds **4 drones**, with a maximum of **20 per player**.

There’s also an **AI drone** costing **10,000 credits**, with a **3,000 km range**. Select a block of **100 tiles** and it physically flies through them one by one, capturing those that are still neutral.

All drones fly at **300 km/h**, so distance and travel time matter. Missions continue while you’re away.

You can see drones flying across the map. Tap one to see its owner, type, speed and ETA — but **other players can’t see its destination or planned route**.

**Defence and wars**

Expansion needs protection:

**Anti-aircraft defences cover a 25 km radius** and can shoot down hostile drones passing within range.

**Troops have a 50 km attack and defence radius**, making their placement important.

Only you can see your units’ coverage circles.

Drones capture neutral land; **armies and wars are how you fight over enemy territory**.

One of the latest additions lets you **select and merge multiple idle armies on the same tile directly from the map**, with a breakdown of their troops.

There are also **friend requests, online presence, private messages between friends, global chat and rankings**.

**Installing it on your phone**

**Android:** open the game in Chrome, then choose **Install app / Add to Home screen** from the browser menu.

**iPhone:** open it in Safari, then tap **Share → Add to Home Screen**.

You’ll also find installation help and a replayable **14-step tutorial in Settings**.

The game is still being developed, and I’m improving it through player feedback. I’d love to hear whether the first steps make sense, how it runs on your phone and what you think of the balance between expanding and defending.

**Would you build a defensive stronghold first, or send your drones out and grab as much territory as possible?**
